passages.title: Park café notice
passages.text:
PARK CAFÉ
Our kitchen is being repaired this week. Hot meals will not be available until Monday, but you can still buy sandwiches, cold drinks and ice creams at the counter. We are sorry for any inconvenience.

passages.title: Swimming pool notice
passages.text:
SWIMMING POOL USERS
From 1 June, children under 8 must have an adult with them in the water at all times. Older children may swim on their own but need to show a pool card, which they can get from reception.

passages.title: Text message
passages.text: Leo, the tennis courts in the park are fully booked tomorrow, so I've reserved one at the sports centre instead. It's further away, so let's meet at the bus stop at 9.30 rather than 10. Sam

passages.title: Sign at the park gate
passages.text: Dogs are welcome in all areas of the park except the children's playground and the flower garden. Please keep your dog on a lead near the lake between April and July, when birds are nesting.

passages.title: Sports centre noticeboard
passages.text:
YOGA CLASSES
Our Tuesday evening class has become so popular that we have added a second class on Thursdays at the same time. Please book online at least a day before, as places cannot be reserved by phone.

questions.question: What does the notice say?
options: a) You can buy cold food this week, but not hot meals.
b) The café is looking for new staff for its kitchen.
c) The café will be completely closed until next Monday.
questions.explanation: The notice says 'Hot meals will not be available until Monday, but you can still buy sandwiches, cold drinks and ice creams'. The café is not closed, because the counter is still selling things, and the problem is a repair, not a lack of staff.

questions.question: What is the new rule at the swimming pool?
options: a) Children under 8 can get a pool card from reception.
b) Young children may not swim without an adult.
c) All children must swim with an adult at all times.
questions.explanation: The notice says 'children under 8 must have an adult with them in the water at all times'. It is not all children, because 'older children may swim on their own', and the pool card is for these older children, not for children under 8.

questions.question: Why has Sam written to Leo?
options: a) To explain why they need to meet earlier than planned
b) To cancel their game because there are no courts free
c) To ask Leo to book a court at the sports centre
questions.explanation: Sam has booked a court at the sports centre, which is 'further away', so Sam suggests meeting 'at 9.30 rather than 10' – earlier than planned. The game is not cancelled, and Sam has already booked the court ('I've reserved one'), so Leo does not need to do it.

questions.question: What does the sign say about dogs?
options: a) They cannot come into the park between April and July.
b) They must be kept on a lead everywhere in the park.
c) They are not allowed in certain parts of the park.
questions.explanation: Dogs are welcome 'in all areas of the park except the children's playground and the flower garden', so there are some parts where they cannot go. Between April and July they can still come in, but must be on a lead only 'near the lake', not everywhere.

questions.question: What is the sports centre telling people?
options: a) The Tuesday yoga class has moved to Thursday.
b) Places in yoga classes can now be booked by phone.
c) There is now an extra yoga class every week.
questions.explanation: The centre says 'we have added a second class on Thursdays', so there is one more class each week. The Tuesday class has not moved – the new class is in addition to it – and places 'cannot be reserved by phone'.
